title: MuleSoft integrations: Capabilities and limitations
summary: Compare MuleSoft and Zapier integrations to determine the right fit for your stack. Learn the key differences in capabilities, ease of use, and pricing for your team.
body_markdown:
**Zapier**


**MuleSoft**


**Integration count**


9,000+


prebuilt app integrations, including for enterprises


250+ prebuilt enterprise connectors


**Best for**


Accessible, scalable, and governed workflow automation across SaaS apps


Enterprise-grade integrations across complex, governed systems


**App coverage**


Strong long-tail support across SaaS, marketing, sales, and AI tools (hard to miss anything with 9,000+


apps)


Strong coverage of ERPs, databases, and on-prem infrastructure, but still limited


**Ease of use**


Beginner-friendly; built for non-developers; also accessible via any agent harness


Steeper learning curve; typically requires developers


**Customization**


Filters, paths, conditional logic, error handling, webhooks, code steps, and custom APIs—no production code required


Deep customization via APIs, SDKs, and custom connectors


**Pricing**


Free plan; paid plans from $19.99/month


Custom enterprise pricing, typically annual contracts


**AI features**


Native AI tools, agentic AI, a[Zapier MCP](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-mcp-guide/) server connecting 9,000+


apps to any MCP-compatible AI client;[Zapier SDK](https://zapier.com/sdk)


API-based AI integrations through Salesforce's broader AI stack; typically developer-led
